D_801C7774 handles B during typing/wait. Choice B resumes four words after 0x8012 instead.
E6C0 returns the 0x8012 sentinel and has a ten-record backing capacity without an in-loop bound check.
The D468 reset does not free existing windows. Return value zero means manager absent; nonzero follows initialization.
Host tests use a pointer-width DialogWord alias. The public declarations retain 32-bit MIPS words and native addresses.

The native input update has void(void) ABI but can block awaiting an SI/controller message; use its existing return boundary. Final source filters only controller-one derived input and scopes AE20 bit 2 within actual local-player pre/late calls, with no persistent AE22 writes.

Native scenario callers can establish AE20/AE22 control locks before entering D468. An initializer entry hook cannot assume current bits belong to the old interaction; cleanup must preserve replacement ownership.
